tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyin sreg cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu badz+ra ya/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas par bshad pa dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gyur med bde chen chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su/ /stong gzugs zung 'jug longs sku'i cha shas rdzogs/ /dag pa'i mtsho la sna tshogs chu zla yi/ /sprul skus khyab mdzad dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyal/ /khyab bdag mchog des spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga ni/ /rnam bzhag rgyas shing lag len mdor bsdus pa/ /mkhas rmongs kun la dga' bskyed 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang bya rgyud legs grub dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / don zhags cho ga zhib mo sogs dang / spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang / bla med kye rdor dang / sam+bu ṭi dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / 'jigs byed rtog bdun dang / khyad par mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i nyer bzhi pa dang / sdom 'byung nyer gsum pa dang nyer brgyad pa rnams nas rgyas par 'byung ba/ slon dpon nag po spyod pa dang / a bha ya dang / dar pan sogs kyi bsdus pa dang / dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs su gsungs pa dang / ye shes zhabs lugs pa'i gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel rnams dang / mar me mdzad chen po'i dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / de'i 'grel par shān+ti pas mdzad pa rnams dang / bod kyi sa skya pa rje btsun snga phyi rnams dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas 'di dang / gsang 'dus dang / yo ga'i sbyin sreg bshad pa kun dang / lo chen gyis bya spyod kyi sbyin sreg mdzad pa rnams legs par brtags te rnam bzhag go sla zhing / dus 'khor zhi rgyas kyi lag len sgrub bde bar brjod par bya'o// //'di la rnam bzhag rgyas par bshad pa dang /

lag len bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la/ spyi dang / khyad par phyi'i sbyin sreg go /dang po ni/ sbyin sreg rnam pa gsum yin te/ bla med nang dang phyi yi'o/ zhes smras te/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes/ bla med nang dang phyi yi ste/ /sbyin sreg rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces dang / sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ phyi yi sbyin sreg cho gas bsgre bya zhing / /yid kyi yang ni yid kyi bya ba ste/ /phung po'i bud shing bsreg par byed pa yi/ /ye shes me rtse bla na med par bshad/ /ces slob dpon mang pos gsungs pa ltar/ ye shes la brten pa bla med/ bza' btung la brten pa nang / cho ga la brten pa phyi'i sbyin sreg go /bla na med pa'ang rnam gsum ste/ spros bral bsam gyis mi khyab dang / 'od gsal bde ba chen po dang / gtum mo rang byin brlab pa'o/ /bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ dgang gzar shes rab blugs gzar thabs/ /de gnyis sbyor ba gnyis med bsgom/ /de las nges 'byung mar gyi rgyun/ /ye shes chen po'i bdud rtsir 'dod/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i bdag nyid kyi/ /me ni de yis yang dag mchod/ /'di ltar sbyin sreg gang byed la/ /skal bzang dngos grub rab tu ster/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shin tu gsal ba'i chos dbyings kyi thab khung du thabs dang shes rab kyi dgang blugs kyis rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me sbar te khams gsum pa'i phung khams skye mched ma lus par bsreg par byed pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsreg blugs dang / phyag chen thig le'i rgyud las/ dbang po gnyis ni sbyor ba las/ /rlung gi me ni sbar ba 'o/ /mar yod pa ni stong 'khor lo/ /de ni mar snod zhes su brjod/ /haṃ gi rnam pas blugs gzar bstan/ /dgang gzar de ni rdo rje 'o/ /bha ga hoṃ khung zhes su brjod/ /byang chub sems kyis mar ni bsreg /ces dang / rjes chags kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyangs pa'i thab khung du haṃ dang rdo rje'i dgang blugs kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis bsreg rdzas sbyin pa bde ba chen po'i bsreg blugs dang /

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ phun tshogs yam shing ye shes me/ /las kyi rlung gis rab sbar nas/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'bar/ /tshangs pa'i me ni sum mdor gnas/ /la la na ni dgang gzar ste/ /blugs gzar na ni ra sa nas/ /dbyug pa rin chen rdo rje'i mtha'/ /thod pa bsreg rdzas snod yin te/ /bsreg bya rdzas rnams thams cad do/ /rim pa de ltar brjod par bya/ /sbyin sreg bla na med pa 'di/ /lha mo khyod la ngas bshad do/ /ces dang / 'od gsal rang byung gi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa rtsa 'khor rnams kyi thab khung du/ ro rkyang gi dgang blugs kyis dwangs ma khyad par can gyi rdzas sbyin par byed pa rang byin brlab kyi bsreg blug rnams ni gtso bor rdzogs rim pa'i sbyin sreg ste nges don nam bla na med pa'o/ /nang ni/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ kha ni hoṃ khung dgang blugs lag /tshul ni rang byung me yin la/ /zhes sogs dang / sgrub thabs kun bzang gi zas kyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su ji ltar bshad pa bzhin no/ /phyi ni/ rgyud rnams su cho ga rgyas par bshad pa kun la grags pa bzhin te/ de na 'dir ni/ bza' btung nang gi sbyin sreg ste/ /yongs su grags pa phyi yi 'o/ /zhes smras pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la rgyud sde spyi'i dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg go /de yang / 'di la rgyud sde spyi dang ni/ /khyad par 'dir bshad gnyis rig bya/ /zhes smras so/ /dang po la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po la/ phyi la zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi/ /phyogs dus chas sam 'dug stangs thabs/ /shing me lha sngags mdog so so/ /gzhan kun spyi dgos thun mong yin/ /zhes smras te/ rmongs rengs dgug bskrad la sogs pa las kyi dbye ba mang yang / bshad rgyud rdor phreng sogs nas 'byung ba sgron gsal le'u bcu bzhi'i mgor bsdus pa ltar gsang sngags spyi 'gro ba thams cad/ zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhir bsdus nas 'chad pas/

de rnams so so la/ gang du byed cing kha blta ba'i phyogs dang / nam gyi tshe byed pa'i dus dang / sgrub pa po'i chas gos dang / bsam pa dang 'dug stangs dang / thab dang / bud shing yam shing dang / me dang / me lha dang / spel tshig gi sngags dang / skabs kyi kha dog rnams ni so sor nges shing / gzhan yang dgang blugs bzung ba'i khu tshur dang / me pra sogs kyang so so ba yod la/ rdor dril dgang blugs rnal 'byor sogs phal che ba ni thun mong ba ste/ de yang thams cad thun mong dang 'jam po gsum gyi dgos kyi thun mong yang yod/ gnyis pa la/ so so ba rnams bshad pa dang / thun mong ba rnams bshad pa'o/ /dang po la phyogs dang / dus la sogs pa ste/ phyogs ni shar byang nub dang lho/ /dkyil 'khor yod na dkyil 'khor de'i/ /phyogs der 'dug nas der kha blta/ /gzhan du grong sogs shar phyogs su'o/ /zhes smras te/ shar du zhi ba/ byang du rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang / lhor drag po'o/ /gzhung lugs la lar lho byang log par bshad kyang / dus ni srod dang tho rang dang / snga dro dgongs mo'am gzhan du bshad/ /ces pa bya rgyud sogs nas srod la zhi ba dang / tho rang bya rog skad mi grag pa'i dus su rgyas pa dang / snga dro dbang dang / phyi dro drag las bya ba'ang bshad la/ gzhan du tho rang dang snga dro go rje ba dang / la lar snga dro zhi ba dang / srod la rgyas pa dang / nyin gung dang nam phyed la drag las bya bar yang bshad de/ phyi ma dus 'khor dang phal cher mthun no/ /chas ni gos dkar shel sogs brgyan/ /gos ser gser dngul rin chen brgyan/ /gos dmar me tog dmar pos brgyan/ /gos nag me tog nag pos brgyan/ /ces pa zhi sogs rim pa bzhin te/ gos bzhin du stan dang dar dpyangs la sogs pa rig par bya'o/ /bsam pa 'jam zhing dul ba dang / /dga' 'dun spro la gzengs bstod dang / /brtse zhing gcugs la chags pa dang / /khro zhing 'khrug la rngam pa 'o/

/zhi sogs rim pa bzhin no/ /'dug stangs pad+ma'i 'dug stangs dang / /bzang po'i 'dug stangs rol pa dang / /phan tshun mnan pa'am g.yas brkyang ngo / /rkang pa phan tshun mnan pa ste gzhan ni go sla la/ zhi ba la spus 'khyud gcugs te bram ze rig byed 'don pa lta bu/ dbang la rkang pa'i mthil sprad pa pad+ma'i skyil krung la lar bshad do/ /thab ni zlum po khru gang dang / /khru bzhi khru ni do pa dang / /zla gam lta bu khru gang dang / /khru gsum sor mo nyi shu ste/ /zab su rang rang phyed phyed tshad/ /mu ran dang ni kha khyer gnyis/ /khru gang pa la sor bzhi bzhi/ /rgyas la nyis 'gyur drag po la/ /sor mo gsum gsum tshad yin te/ /kha khyer rnams la rdo rje dang / /rin chen pad+ma rdo rje gyes/ /nang dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /lte ba'i mtshan ma'ang de rnams te/ /zhi la 'khor lo bshad pa'ang yod/ /'dab mar rigs bzhi yum bzhi 'o/ /phyi rol rdo rje phyed pas mtshan/ /thab rgyas dal gyis bskor ba 'o/ /zhes smras te/ rgyud sde gong 'og kun nas thab kyi tshad gang bshad du 'di ltar bshad cing rgya bod kyi mkhas pa kun gyis kyang rgyas bsdus mdzad pa ma mthong la/ 'phags pa rin po ches ji skad bshad pa 'di dag ni thab chung bsdus pa yin gyi/ chen po ni zhi ba la khru do pa nas bcu drug pa'i bar te de bzhin du gzhan la'ang sbyar bar gsungs pa la ni khungs btsal bar bya'o/ /dbyibs ni rgyas pa la rin po che zur brgyad pa lta bu dang / dbang la phyag rgya'i chos 'byung dang pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu'ang mdo sde sogs su bshad do/ /mu ran dang kha khyer ni/ rje btsun gong mas snga phyi slog ste gsungs shing / mdo ste dang kṝ ya sa muts+tshar sor bzhi dor bar kha khyer zhes dang / sor bzhi spangs par zhes sogs ma gtogs mu ran gyi ming ma byung la/ dus 'khor du mu ran gyi dod du mchu zhes gsung mod kyi/ gang ltar nang rder 'gag gi nang khyer phyir la sgyed nas steng du ngos bstan pa lta bu ni snga ma dang /

yang steng du langs pa de nyid spangs dang mnyam par phyir la bskyed nas ngos steng du bstan pa cig la mtshan mas brgyan pa ni phyi ma yin la/ phyi ma 'di'i skad dod la be dī zhes 'byung zhing / 'di snam bu la yang 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi kha khyer la 'dod snam du grags pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir snga ma mchu'am mu ran/ phyi ma kha khyer du rigs so/ /'phags pas kha khyer gyi nang gnyis kyi bar du mu ran mdzad pa la'ang shes byed med la/ dus 'khor du mchu dang kha khyer gyi bar du re kha zhes pa cig 'byung ba ni de dang mi 'dra'o/ /kha khyer gyi mtshan ma ni zhi ba la 'khor lo dang / dbang gi dgug pa la lcags kyu 'dam khar bshad pa yang yod la phal cher ni rtsa ba bzhin no/ /kha khyer gyi phyi rol du dus 'khor las pad 'dab phyir la 'phyang ba cig bshad kyang gsang sngags gzhan du thab bsdus pa la rtsa thig lta bu gru bzhi pa cig byas pa'i rdo rje phyed pas brgyan pa nyid bshad la/ kha cig las zla phye dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de ni bsdus pa yin la/ thab rgyas pa ni rang rang gi skabs de'i dkyil 'khor gang yin me ri dang dur khrod kyi bar gyis bskor ba gru bzhi la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ thab kyi lte ba'i pad 'dab ni dbus kyi gshegs pa gshegs ma'am snying po'i lha dang kha khyer gyi de ma thag nas rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa bzhi dang lha snam sogs sam/ bde mchog gi thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor sgo mtshams ma dang bcas pa sogs su bya bar rje btsun gong ma rnams bzhed cing / 'phags pas dur khrod dang rdo rwa'i bar du khor yug byas nas/ shar du tshangs pa/ lhor dbang phyug nub tu khyab 'jug byang du gzhon nu karti ka 'khor dang bcas pa'i mtshan ma/ shar phyogs su/ pad+ma dbyu gu phreng ba dang / /spyi blugs ri dwags pags pa 'o/ /lhor ni rtse gsum zla tshes dang / /rgyal mtshan ral pa'i thor tshugs mig

/nub tu 'khor lo dung dang ni/ /dbyug tho ral gri phub rnams so/ /byang du mdung dang dril bu dang / /ba dan rma bya ra skyes bri/ /zhes gsungs pa ni yo ga'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'chugs par snang la/ mthar mda' dgu dang me long bzhi dang tshon skud phur bu bcus skor bar bshad pa ni bya rgyud 'ga' zhig 'chugs par snang bas bla med la dgos par ma mthong ngo / /dbang gi thab tu dgug pa dang / drag po'i thab tu bsad bskrad dbye ba rmongs rengs la sogs pa drag las thams cad bya la/ spel tshig dang sgrub bya la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin so sos 'grub par mdo snyer byung ba bzhin bla ma gong ma dag kyang bzhed la/ gong mas sam+bu ṭi'i rgyud phyi ma'i don du mdzad nas/ rgyas thab gru bzhi pa khru do pa'i dbus su zhi ba'i zlum po khru gang / de'i nang gru gsum du bcad pa ni drag po dang / bcad mtshams zla gam gsum po dbang ste/ las so so'i kha dog sogs byas pas las thams cad 'grub par bshad la/ rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ yang na yid ni gang dga' bar/ /khru gang zlum po kha khyer bcas/ /pad+ma rgyas pa lta bu yi/ /kha khyer sor bzhi'i tshad tsam gyi/ /kha ni pad+ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /zhes sogs kyi zhi ba'i thab nyid kyi dbus dang kha khyer gyi mtshan ma las so so bzhin du rje ba'am/ mdo snyer rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i phyag mtshan du byas pas las thams cad par 'gyur bar bshad la/ grub na thams cad la brus pa 'am brtsigs pa'i thab bya zhing / ma grub na bri bar bya ste/ bris pa la ni dpangs rnams bsgom par bya ba tsam du zad do/ /bud shing kun la dgon pa'i shing / /zhes pa ni/ bud shing dang yam shing so sor phye ba'i bud shing ste/ thams cad la grong las rgyang grags kyi 'phags pa'i ri'i ljongs kyi gci ba skam po srog chags med cing gtsang ba ste zhi ba la ni yam shing gzhan med na 'di nyid kyi rung ba mdo snye rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa bzhed par mngon la/

las gzhan yam shing 'di las gzhan pa nges par dgos shing / yam shing gis 'dang na ni bud shing yang mi dgos te/ bud shing ni dang por brtsig pa'i shing ngam phyis snon pa'i shing 'bul sngags la sogs pa med par rtsig pa la bya ste/ zhi ba la thab las rgya dpang cung zad chung ba dang / rgyas pa la mnyam po dang / dbang drag la ji ltar rnyed pa'o/ /yam shing 'o ma can gyi rtse/ /dri zhim dkar gsum sbags pa ni/ /mthe chung dang mnyam mtho gang tshad/ /'bras bu can gyi sked pa'i cha/ /ro mngar mngar gsum sbags pa ni/ /lag ngar dang mnyam khru gang tshad/ /me tog dmar pos rgyan pa skyur/ /pho mo'i dri chur snyugs pa dang / /dug tsher can gyis rtsa ba'i cha/ /khyi brun dug khrag skra spu bsres/ /sor brgyad pa dang sor bcu pa/ /sbom phra ji ltar 'tshams pa ste/ /dang po gsum po drang zhing mdzes/ /tha ma sgur skyog dri ro nga / /zhes pa ste/ zhi ba la ni/ a shat+tha dang u dum+bā ra dang / pa la sha dang slak+ṣa la sogs pa ste/ bod na ba lu dang lcags skya la sogs pa 'o ma can gyi rtse mo'i cha las skyes pa lo ma gnyis dang ldan pa rlan dang bcas pa mnyam por bcad pa'o/ /rgyas pa'ang de rnams sam 'bras bu can gyi sked pa'i cha la skyes pa khu tshur dang chang ba'i tshad tsam ces bshad kyang lag ngar phra sa tsam mo/ /dbang la tsam pa ka dang / nā ga ge sar dang / a sho ka la sogs pa me tog dmar po can ro skyur ba ste/ bod na kham bu la zhi rgyas dbang gsum kas rung ngo / /drag po la nim+pa dang seng ldeng dang myos byed sogs te bod na skyer pa dang skyi bar grags pa sogs kyi rtsa ba'am/ ro bsregs pa'i 'gal dum dang / bong bu dang rnga mo'i rbang la sogs pa rnams la dgra'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang bshang gci dang / yung mar dang / lañtsha dang / ke tshe dang / khyim bya'i tshil bu sogs kyang bsre bar bya'o/ /las phyi ma gnyis kyi shing tshad ni a bha yas bshad la/ dbang la zhi ba dang mnyam par sa lugs pa dag bzhed do/

/las 'jam po gsum la drang shing mdzes la tshad ldan dgos par ni/ rnying lci phra dang skyon po dang / /ring thung lo ma med pa dang / /srog chags kyis zos rul pa dang / /shun bral chag dang bu ga can/ /rtse mo gnyis ldan sbom po spangs/ /zhes dang / nyes dmigs ni/ rnying pa yis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /skyog pos bskal ba ngan par 'gyur/ /ring thung 'phral du rig pa nyams/ /lo ma med pas na tsha 'byung / /sbom pos phun sum tshogs pa nyams/ /sgam pos gzhan yang mi 'dod 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /drag po la ni/ drag po'i rdzas la dgra'i gzugs brnyan bya ste/ rkang pa g.yon pa nas rim gyis bcad pa yam shing dang bsre bar yang bshad do/ /me ni bram ze'i rgyun zhag gam/ /'o ma can gnyis btsubs pa'i me/ /nags chen tshig gam rgyal rigs me/ /smad 'tshong khyim mam rje rigs me/ /dur khrod me 'am gdol pa'i me/ /zhes te/ zhi ba la dgon pa'i me dang / rgyas pa la me shel las byung ba dang dge 'dun gyi tshang bang las byung ba dang / dbang la me tog dmar po'i shing btsubs pa dang / sprang pos lam du bus pa/ drag po la rdo dang lcags brdabs pa las byung ba rnams kyang bshad la gtso bor ni rtsa ba'i go rim bzhin no/ /me lha rgyud gzhan rnams su/ zhal gcig phyag bzhir bshad na yang / bla med phal cher zhal gsum dang phyag drug par bshad/ dang po gnyis/ /rang snang rigs 'khyud g.yas pa gnyis/ /phreng ba mi 'jigs g.yon pa gnyis/ /ril ba dbyu gu 'dzin pa ste/ /sbom thung bsus 'phyang ral pa dang / /ag tshoms 'bar shing rgyan gos ldan/ /zhi dkar zhal 'dzum cung zad gdangs/ /rgyas ser bzhad cing de las gdangs/ /dbang dmar chags shing 'dzum bag 'gying / /drag nag khros 'khrugs khams gsum za/ /rim bzhin sa chu me dang rlung / /dkyil 'khor bzhi la gnas par bshad/ /ces pa/ rgyu sde 'og ma gsum dang dus 'khor zhal gcig phyag bzhi par bshad pa bzhin/

bod snga ma 'ga' zhig gis bla med spyi la yang sbyar mod kyi/ 'grel pa rnams dang mdo snye sogs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin 'byung ba ni legs te/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/ sngags kyi skyes bu thams cad ni/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes rdzogs/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dngos po thams cad brtag par bya/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /sngags ni zhi sogs 'dod pa'i tshig /so so'i 'jug tu swā hā dang / /oṃ dang hoḥdang dzaḥdang ni/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ni sbyar bar bya/ /zhes pa/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ tshe dang blo gros dang dpal sbyor thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ rgyal po dang lha la sogs pa wa shaṃ ku ru ho'am/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pa dbang gi dgug pa la'o/ /drag po'i rmongs rengs la che ge mo'i sems mo ha ya dang / lus stam+bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ bsad bskrad la ma ra ya dang / uts+tsha ya phaṭa/ ces sogs skabs dang sbyar ba bya zhing shes na/ rgya skad du bya'o/ /mdog ni thab dang bsreg rdzas sogs/ /kun la dkar por dmar nag me/ /zhes pa las bzhi la rim pa bzhin te/ dkar rtsi dang / gur gum dang / bin du dang / sol ba lta bus so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhan ni rnal 'byor rdor dril dang / /dgang blugs bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas sogs/ /zhes smras te/ rnal 'byor ni/ mdun bskyed sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na thab khung gi sa brtag blang sbyang ba sogs kyi sa chog dang / srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung dang / 'brel na me tog gis lha thab tu spyan drang ba dang / gnyis ka la bsreg rdzas mchod rdzas dang thab dang yo byad bsham pa dang / 'dug nas rdor dril gzung ba dang / yo byad byin gyis brlab pa dang / me blangs te sbor ba dang / thab dang me dang me lha bskyed pa dang / ye shes pa spyan drangs te chu bzhis mchod nas gzhug cing mnyes par bya ba dang / lce dang dgang gzar gyis kha byin gyis brlabs nas byon zan nam bsreg blugs 'bul ba dang /

chu bzhi nyer spyod kyis mchod nas bsreg rdzas rdzogs par 'bul ba dang / me lha me 'bar ba'i rnam par bsgyur ba'am/ thab kyi me mtshams kyi kha khyer la bzhag ste me nang du'am/ yang na me lha nyid kyi thugs kar yang rung ste 'das pa dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na gsar du bskyed pa'am 'brel na spyan drangs nas gsal gdab pa gang rung gi sgrub pa la me lha bzhin du byas te rdzogs nas slar yang mchod bstod sor rtsi na bza' phul nas bzod gsol gsol gdab byas te gshegs su gsol nas/ 'jug me lha thab tu spyan drangs pa'am gsal gdab pa la'ang de bzhin du byed pa rnams kyi gzhung shing la/ las bzhi khyad par med do/ /gong ma'i phyag len gyi khyad par la sa lugs pa dag me lha'i bsreg blugs kyi 'jug tu ku sha 'bul/ gzhan me sbar ma thag tu 'bul/ kha cig 'das pa la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i sngags rang rang gi gtso bo'i sngags kyis byed/ kha cig me lha'i sngags kyis byed/ kha cig gnyis kas byed do/ /bsreg rdzas rgya gzhung phal cher las/ yam shing gi 'jug tu/ mar dang til dang zho zan dang / sā lu dang 'bru rnams zhes sogs mdor bsdus ma gtogs gsal po ma byung yang / rgyud sdom 'byung du/ mar gyi 'byor pa thams cad byed/ /yam shing gzi brjid rnam par 'phel/ /bud shing lhag par dpa' bar byed/ /ku shas thams cad bsrung bar byed/ /yung kar gyis bgegs zhi bar byed/ /'bras kyis rgyas par byed par bshad/ /til gyis sdig pa 'joms rig bya/ /so bas nor dang 'bru rnams 'gugs/ /sran mas stobs ni chen por byed/ /nas kyis rlung gi shugs rab ster/ /dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed/ /gro yis nad ni 'joms par byed/ /'o ma sbrang rtsis shes rab 'phel/ /zas mchog gis ni bde kun ster/ /mes ni 'dod don dngos grub ster/ /rang 'dod lhas ni grol ba stsol/ /lhag mas las ni rjes mthun par/ /zhi sogs las byas shes par bya/

/zhes 'byung zhing / go rim kyang bod snga mas rgyud tshig gi rim pa bzhin byas pa'ang snang mod kyi/ mdo snyer/ shing / mar/ til/ dur ba/ 'bras ma grugs pa/ zho zan/ ku sha/ yungs kar/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ me tog dang 'bras sna tshogs bshad pa bod phyi ma dag gi phyag len la yod pa bzhin bya'o/ /rgyud rgya gzhung kun tu mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rang rang gi sngags kyis brgya rtsa brgyad du byin gyis brlab par bshad pa sha stag snang yang / da lta 'bul ba'i tshe brjod par byed de/ gzhan rnams des 'grub kyang chu bzhi'i byin rlabs sogs la sngags nyung ba'i skyon yod do/ /chu bzhi yang dgang blugs kyi sngon du ye shes pa dang / de bcug tshar ba'i yan lag bzhi rdzogs gnyis ka la bzhi ka 'bul bar mthun la/ 'jug tu mchod yon rkyang pa'am/ zhabs sil med pa'i gsum 'bul ba shas che ba'i go rim kyang 'byung mod kyi/ bsang gtor thog mar 'bul ba skabs dang 'brel lo/ /de dag ni las bzhi spyi'i thun mong yin la/ dgos kyi thun mong ni/ 'jam po gsum la bsreg rdzas g.yas/ /mchod rdzas spyi'am mchod yon g.yon/ /lag gnyis spus mo'i nang du gnas/ /drag po de las zlog par bshad/ /ces pa sam+bu ṭi las/ bsreg rdzas rnams ni g.yas su bzhag /chu bzhi'i snod ni g.yon du ste/ /mar gyi snod ni mdun du 'o/ /zhes dang / gru mo spus mo'i bar bcug ste/ /blugs gzar gyis ni mar bcus te/ /dgang gzar byas nas bsreg par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo snye sogs nas kyang bshad pas/ me tog la sogs pa g.yas g.yon mi gsal zhing / yo gar bsreg rdzas kyi khrod du 'jog par bshad mod kyi/ bla ma snga phyi phal cher g.yon du shom pa bzhin bya la/ drag po la ni thams cad zlog par bya'o/ /dgang blugs 'dzin pa'i khu tshur ni/ byang chub mchog dang nor bu dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i khu tshur ro/ /zhes pa kṝ ya sa muts+tshar/ zhi rgyas la sogs las rnams la/

/byang chub mchog dang nor bu dang / /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i khu tshur bzhis/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar gzung ba bstan/ /zhes 'byung ste rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis dang / gung mo gnyis dang / mthe chung ma gtogs pa gzhan gsum dang / mdzub mo'ang mthe'u chung rnams brkyang pa'o/ /gzung bya dgang blugs kyi rgyu ni/ gser dngul zangs lcags sogs rin po che'am/ mchod sbyin gyi shing rnams so/ /tshad ni gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa las/ yu ba khru do pa dang dgang gzar gyi mgo la khru gang pa'ang bshad ces rje btsun gong mas bshad kyang / rgyud dang rgya gzhung kun tu yu ba khru gang pa mgo bo mtho gang pa nyid bshad cing / dus 'khor dbang ler khru gang nang la sbyar ba'i tshad nges bshad pa dang sbyar nas/ de gnyis yu ba khru re'i tshad/ /mgo bor sor bzhi sor gnyis pa/ /gru bzhi pad+ma'i dbyibs can te/ /rang rang phyed de zabs su bru/ /lte bar rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan/ /nor bu rdo rjes spras pa ni/ /chu srin kha nas dbyung zhing mdzes/ /yu ba'i mthar yang rdo rjes brgyan/ /zhes pa gnyis ka'i thun mong ste/ yu ba'i sbom du tshang par gzung du rung ba/ dgang gzar gyi mgo bo sor bzhi pa gru bzhi dang / blugs gzar gyi sor gnyis pa pad 'dab bam ba'i mig gi dbyibs can/ zabs su sor gnyis dang gcig pa/ gnyis ka'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ yu ba phyogs su rdo rje dang nor bu gnyis ka'am gang rung sor bzhi dang gnyis pa chu srin gyi kha nas byung pa/ yu ba'i mthar yang rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ /khyad par du dgang gzar la ni kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas skor ba dang / rtse mor rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i/ /dbus rwa bug par khu bcud 'dzag /las rnams kun la dbye de gsungs/ /ces pa go sla la/ de ltar bsdoms pa dgang gzar gyi mgo la sor bcu gnyis 'byung ba yin no/ /'di dag ni las bzhi ka'i thun mong du gsungs pas dbye byed du byas pas chog la/

las so so la cis kyang 'byed na lte ba'i mtshan mas dbye/ zhes pa thab kyi dbus dang kha khyer gyi mtshan ma ji bzhin las so so dang las thams cad pa la bla ma dag gis mdzad do/ /'di dag ni gtso bor bla med la sbyar ba ste/ nang gi rnal 'byor khyad par ba dang / rdzas rnams la yang nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pas bran pa gal che la/ cho ga gzhan kun thun mong nyid/ /bskyed chog phyag rgya bzhis btab sogs/ /cung zad bsnan pas bzhi ka 'grub/ /ces pa/ bya spyod sbyin sreg rnam snang mngon byang sogs nas 'byung ba lo chen gyis bsdus pa la yang / cho ga phal cher 'di bzhin du yod pas thun mong du khas blangs la/ khyad par rgyud sde rang rang gi gnas dang yo byad dang lha bsang ba dang / bcing ba dang / rang rang gi bskyed chog dang / yo ga la phyag rgya bzhis btab khyad par ba byed tshul dang / me lha yum med pa'i phyag gnyis pa'am bzhi par byed pa sogs sbyar bas rgyud sde bzhi ka'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bzhag ni 'grub la/ 'di na rang rang gi rnal 'byor shes na 'don pa spos pas 'grub pa'i phyir 'dir mi spro'o/ /de bzhin du rtsa tshig gis dngos su ma bsdus pa/ mchod yon sogs kyi snod kyang / las gsum la shel dang gser dngul zangs shing rdo rnams dang / drag po la rdza dang thod pa la sogs par sngags rnams kyi mjug tu swā hā dang / oṃ sogs sngar bshad pa rnams sbyar te bzlas nas bsham pa dang / me ltas brtag tshul sam bu ṭi dang sdom 'byung nas rgyas par gsungs pa mdo snye sogs su bsdus pa ni/ 'od zer dang bcas g.yas su 'khor/ snum zhing dri zhim du ba med/ /gser dngul byi ru 'ja' tshon mdog /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bum pa nya/ /dpal be'u pad+ma rnga yab dang / /ral gri rin chen rdo rje dung / /pad+ma dgang blugs rtse gsum dbyibs/ /rnga sgra pi wang snyan pa'i sgra/ /kha dog las bzhi rang rang mdog /me yi rtse mo gcig gnyis gsum/

/rab 'bring tha mar rim bzhin bshad/ /'bar dka' me lce 'chad pa dang / /rtsub nag pa la sha yi mdog /me stag 'phro dang drag po'i sgra/ /dri nga de ltar mi dge'i ltas/ /drag po'i las la shis pa 'o/ /zhes par 'dus te rgyas par rgyud dang de rnams su blta'o/ /de ltar mi shes na bgegs sbyangs ba'i sngags dang bsam gtan la sogs pa byas te bya'o/ /rgyud sde spyi'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bzhag bshad pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa dus 'khor 'dir bshad pa la las so so ba dang / thams cad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud 'dir phrin las rgyas par phye na drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / 'bring du bsdu na las chen bcu gnyis dang / bsdu na brgyad de/ brgyad ni/ zhi rgyas gnyis/ dbang dgug gnyis/ rmongs rengs gnyis/ bsad bskrad gnyis so/ /'di rnams phyogs rim pa bzhin byang dang / lho dang / nub dang / shar du bya bar gsungs pa las kyi khams kyang phyogs de rnams dang mthun no/ /de yang snga ma snga ma rnams rang rang gi phyogs de'i mtshams dang phyi ma phyi ma rnams rang rang gi phyogs nyid du bya ba yin no/ /bcu gnyis su 'byed na/ zhi rgyas gzhil gsum/ dbang dgug bskyed gsum/ rmongs rengs gdab gsum/ bsad bskrad dbye gnyis zhes bya la/ gzhil ba ni rims de nyid du zhi bar byed pa dang / bskyed pa ni rims gnas sam gang zag gzhan la dpes gtong ba'o/ /gdab pa ni phur bus gdab pa dang / dbye ba ni mdza' bo 'byed pa ste/ snga ma bzhi'am drug 'jam po dang / phyi ma bzhi'am drug drag po'o/ /des na/ 'dir bshad las chen bcu bzhi po/ /brgyad du bsdus nas phyogs dus sogs/ /so so ba dang / zhes smra ste/ dbang le'i mdor bsdus dang po dang / bzhi pa gnyis legs par bsgrigs nas shes dgos la/ rgyas par byas na yi ge mang par 'gyur bas gzhan lugs kyi 'dod pa phyin ci log dgag pa'i spros pa dor nas rang 'dod mdor bsdus te go sla bar brjod na/

phyogs sogs sngar bzhin las/ phyogs ni bshad ma thag pa ste/ rims gzhil ba sogs phyi ma bzhi yang rgyas pa sogs kyi gnas te phyogs rnams su bya la/ de yang dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na gtso bo zhal gang du gzigs pa la shar du byas pa'i phyogs de dang der bya zhing / rgyal po'i grong khyer chen po'i phyogs mtshams brgyad na dur khrod yod pas gang du yang zhi rgyas mi rung bas na/ nang gi rgyal po'i pho brang dngos kyi phyogs de rnams su dang / dur khrod med pa'i grong spyi'i phyi rol gyi de rnams su'o/ /dus ni brgyad po rgyud 'grel du byang nas g.yas skor du bshad pa ltar/ nyin zhag la thun brgyad du byas nas nyin gyi bzhi la rim pa bzhin zhi rgyas dang bsad bskrad/ mtshan gyi bzhi la dbang dgug rmongs rengs/ stan gcig la de tsam bya bar mi nus na nyin mtshan gnyis ka la thun brgyad brgyad du byas te nyin la brgyad rim bzhin sbyar ba dang mtshan la yang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya yi/ nyin phyed mtshan phyed dang nam langs ka dang sa srod mtshams te thun mtshams bzhi dang dus me la sogs pa'i gza' gdug pa dang dus sbyor gdug pa can 'char ba'i dus ni zhi rgyas la spangs par dngos su gsungs pa ltar 'jam po kun la yang spangs te drag las la shes par gsungs pas so/ /chas dgos kyang / zhi rgyas/ bsad bskrad/ dbang dgug rmongs rengs/ de rnams kyi phyogs dus kyi nges pa khams nges pa ltar dkar nag dmar ser rnams te/ thabs la sogs pa'i kha dog dang me lha'i mdog dang / mdun bskyed kyi 'od zer rnams kyang de nyid do/ /bsam pa yang spyi 'gro dang 'dra bar sgrub ler gsungs so/ /'dug stangs ni brgyad po rim pa bzhin/ rkang pa g.yon pa bskum pa'i spus mo'i steng du g.yas pa gan rkyal du bzhag pa skyil krung dang / phan tshun gyi brla'i steng du gan rkyal du bzhag pa rdo rje'i gdan dang / spus mo g.yon gyi steng du g.yas bzhag cing rkang mgo yang de bzhin dang zlog pa'ang rung ba lha min gyi gdan dang /

rkang pa gnyis bshibs pa'i rting par 'phong tshos su bzhag cing brla dang byin pa steng du langs pa'i tsog pu dang / g.yon skyil krung dang g.yas tsog pu dang / de las zlog pa dang / g.yon gyi rting par bshang lam bzhag cing g.yas tsog pu dang / de las zlog pa rnams so/ /thab ni zla ba'i rang bzhin zlum po khru gang pa dang / zla ba nyis 'gyur gyi rang bzhin gru bzhi khru do pa dang / sgra gcan ni rlung gi rang bzhin zla gam zur gnyis pa dang / rlung me gnyis ka'i rang bzhin zur lnga pa gnyis sor bcu gnyis pa dang nyer bzhi pa/ me'i rang bzhin zur gsum pa dang / me sa gnyis ka'i rang bzhin zur bdun pa gnyis sor nyi shu pa dang bzhi bcu pa/ rlung dang sa'i rang bzhin zur drug pa dang / sa dang ri rab kyi rang bzhin zur brgyad pa gnyis sor sum bcu pa dang drug cu pa ste phyogs rnams rang rang gi mtshams las nyis 'gyur du gyur pa ni/ 'dir mtshams thabs dang / phyogs shes rab tu byas la 'di ni bsam pas bzhag cing / gzhan kha khyer du zlog pa ni lus kyi dbang gis so/ /rang rang gi phyed ni zabs kyi tshad dang / mchu dang mtshan ma'i phreng ba'am re kha ni bcu gnyis cha dang / kha khyer ni drug cha dang / kha 'phyang ni de dang mnyam pa ste/ rang rang gi nang du shong ba'i zlum skor la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bya bar ni khyad med la/ khyad par ni/ mtshan ma dang kha khyer gyi phyi rol kha 'phyang dang / de'i mthar yang dgram bya'i rdzas kyis 'byed cing / mtshan ma ni pad+ma'i lte bar gang bgod pa de kha khyer gyi dbus kyi lnga gsum la'ang phreng bar bya bar gsungs pa ste/ de ltar na mtshan ma ni rim pa bzhin pad+ma dang 'khor lo dang / gri gug dang / ral gri dang / mda' dang / lcags kyu dang / sbrul dang / lcags bsgrog rnams so/ /kha 'phyang ni/ zhi rgyas la pad 'dab/ bsad pa la mi lag gi phreng ba/ bskrad pa la bya rog gi sgro/ dbang du dgug la pad+ma dmar po/ rmongs rengs la arka'i 'dab ma'o/

/rdzas dgod bya zhing / zhi rgyas la dur ba rtse mo sngon po thab kyi shar du bstan pa'i mjug ma rtse mo gzhan gyis bkris ste 'khor ba/ bsad pa la ro'i skra/ bskrad pa 'byung po'i shing lo/ dbang dgug la me tog dmar po/ rmongs rengs la me tog ser po'o/ /'dir kha cig re kha'i phreng ba las thams cad pa la yin gyi so so ba 'di la bshad zer mod/ mdor bsdus dang por mtshan ma'i phreng ba mchu dang mnyam par bshad pa de so so ba'i skabs yin pa dang / de dang mchu bsdoms pas kha khyer dang mnyam pa ni gsang sngags spyi 'gro dang mthun no/ /brgyad po thams cad kyi phyi rol du khru do dor bar 'jam po rnams la nang nas bskyed rim dang drag po la zlog pa'i ra ba'am rtsig pa gsum dang / rang rang gi nub phyogs su sgo gcig pa rta babs dang bcas pa skabs 'di dag tu bshad cing / nang ler sgo bzhi pa'ang bshad do/ /rtsig pa'i nang gis khru gnyis po'i sa la khro bo bcu'i mtshan ma dang / slob dpon dang / mchod rdzas dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyi gdan thab kyi lte ba'i dbyibs dang tshad dang mtshan ma rnams ji bzhin byas la/ 'on kyang thab kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la ni rigs bzhi yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan dgod cing / 'di gsum la dbus kyi mtshan ma gcig pus chog go /gdan 'di dag zhi ba la lho nub dang / rgyas pa la lho ru dang / bsad pa la rlung du dang / bskrad dbye la nub tu dgod pa sogs rang rang gi phyogs kyi zlog phyogs su 'god par bshad pa ni/ kha cig 'jig rten spyi 'gro'i dbang du byas nas bshad pas ma 'grig pa shin tu mang la/ me lha dang slob dpon mdun sprad du nges pas/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i tshe zhi rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi byang du thab byas/ sgo dkyil 'khor phyogs la bstan/ me lha de la rgyab bstan pas 'jig rten spyi'i byang la zhal bstan pa'ang yong srid cing ma byung na yang / slob dpon nyid dkyil 'khor gyi byang la kha bstan pa nges par yong zhing des skabs don yang 'grub pa sogs yin pas na mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i tshe thab kyi gtso bo me lha yin pas de'i zhal gang du bstan pa'i phyogs de/

mdor na thab kyi shar phyogs kho nar gdan rnams bya zhing / ma 'brel na grong gi byang shar du zhi ba'i thab byas te/ 'jig rten spyi la bltos pa'i gdan yong pa byang shar du 'byung zhing gzhan la'ang de bzhin du sbyar bas bde blag tu 'grub pa yin no/ /shing ni zhi rgyas la u dum+ba ra a shar+thā dang n+ya gro dha dang / sarka ṭi dang / dgun 'brum gyi ste 'o ma can no/ /bsad pa la ni mi rus mthe'u chung gi dbyibs can no/ /dbye bskrad la bya rog gi mjug ma'o/ /dbang la seng ldeng / dgug pa la sna la sha rmongs pa la smyo byed/ rengs pa la bil ba rnams las skyes pa ste zhi rgyas kyi dang / 'di bzhi sbom phra rim pa bzhin/ mthe'u chung nas mthe bong gi bar te/ ring thung mi rus ni mthe'u chung gi tshad dang gzhan thams cad sor bcu gnyis pa'o/ /rdzas kyang zhi ba la 'o ma durba til/ rgyas pa la mar dang 'bru lnga/ bsad pa la dug dang mi'i sha khrag bskrad dbye la ke tshe dang lañtsha zhag dbang la ka ra bi ra'i sogs me tog dmar po dang rngul/ dgug pa la bil ba'i 'bru 'dab dang gcin/ rengs pa la phreng ba rnying pa dang 'chil ma/ rmongs pa la da du ra'i me tog dang chang rnams lhan cig ste/ yam shing sogs rdzas thams cad lnga brgya bzhi bcu ni 'das pa la dgos pas 'jig rten pa'i dang bcas pa'o/ /me ni zhi rgyas sogs te tshan bzhi la rim pa bzhin bram ze dang / gdol pa'am dmangs rigs dang / rgyal rigs dang rje'u rigs kyi khyim nas blang pa'o/ /lha ni zhi rgyas la dkar po snang mtha'i dbu rgyan can/ g.yas pad+ma dang shel phreng / g.yon ril ba dang dung 'dzin pa dang / g.yas 'khor lo dang mu tig gi phreng ba/ g.yon pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /bsad bskrad la nag po gos dang bcas pa don grub kyi dbu rgyan/ g.yas gri gug dang rtse gsum/ g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'dzin pa dang / g.yon de bzhin la g.yas ral gri dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/

/dbang dgug la dmar po rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can g.yas mda' dang rin po che/ g.yon gzhu dang me long 'dzin pa dang / g.yas lcags kyu dang rin po che/ g.yon zhags pa dang me long 'dzin pa'o/ /rmongs rengs la ser po rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ g.yas sbrul dang dbyug pa/ g.yon 'khor lo dang tho ba 'dzin pa dang / g.yas lcags bsgrog dang tho ba/ g.yon 'khor lo dang phur pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad ral pa ser skya dang / gos dmar ser dkar nag dmar ser bzhi po chu rlung me sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing yi ge las byung pa sa zhi khro chags 'gying gi nyams can du bshad la/ ra la zhon pa dang lus tsho ba sogs kyang gzhan nas kha skang / de lta bu'i dam tshig pa me'i nang dang rang gi snying ga gnyis kar du bskyed/ snying ga'i de ye shes pa'i tshul du stim/ slar yang ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa sogs zhi rgyas la sbyor ba ji bzhin kun la 'dra bar bya dgos te/ sngags ni dkyil 'khor gyi mchod sngags las so so la na maḥl sogs pa'i mtha' so sor nges pa yod kyang / me mchod pa'i sngags thams cad swā hā'i mtha' can du gsungs pa ltar spel tshig gi mtha'i sngags kyang sbyin sreg gi skabs su las thams cad la swā hā'i mtha' can du byed pa mdor bsdus bzhi pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa yin no/ /mdog ni brjod zin no/ /mchod pa'i snod ni brgyad po rim bzhin shel dngul thod lcags gser zangs shing sa rnams las byas pa sor bcu gnyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbyibs can mchod rdzas kyang 'byor na so so'i rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin med na'ang mos pas 'grub bo/ /dgang blugs kyi yu ba snying ga nas gsang ba'i dang / mdzod spu nas snying ga'i dbu ma dag pas khru re dang / mgo bo lag mthil dang mnyam pa sor drug pa dang / rtse mo rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i dbus ma la bu ga bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jam po rnams las kun pa zhes bsdus nas gsungs/

zhes smras te/ 'di la kha cig las brgyad ka 'dir bshad pa'i las thams cad pa'i thab tu byar rung bar 'dod pa yod kyang / zhi rgyas kyi thab zlum po khru do dang khru bzhi gru bzhi gnyis las ni ma gsungs la/ zhi rgyas kyi thab tu drag las byed pa'ang skabs kyi tshul dang mi mthun zhing / 'di'i mdor bsdus dang por/ las thams cad pa'i sgras ni zhi ba la sogs pa dang dbang la sogs pa'i las drug ste bsad pa la sogs pa dang phur bus gdab pa la sogs pa drug ni ma yin no zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'jam po drug po thab 'di gnyis su sbyar rung ba yin no/ /las so so ba'i zhi rgyas dang 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ 'di nyis 'gyur gyi che ba dang / thab dngos kyi nang gi phyed la gtso bo'i pad+ma ljang gu bder gshegs 'phar ma dang bcas pa ste zlum po la de rnams kyang zlum por bya zhing de dag la dgos pa'i mtshan ma bum pa sogs kyang dkyil 'khor ji bzhin bya ba dang / de nas dpang chen dpang chung lha snam lha rnams la mtshan ma dgod pa yang don gyi thob la/ de nas mchu dang ro kha dang kha khyer dang kha 'phyang rnams thab rang rang gi bcu gnyis cha gnyis dang drug cha gnyis su byed pa sngar bzhin byas pas kha khyer tshun gyi rtsig pa nas mda' yab kyi bar gyi tshad 'gro ba dang / kha 'phyang gi mtha' nas khru do bor bar rwa ba gsum pa nub kyi sgo rta babs dang bcas pa rnams snga ma bzhin du gsungs so/ /las 'jam po so so ba dang thams cad pa kun la bsreg rdzas g.yas dang mchod rdzas g.yon du bsham pa dang / drag po la de las zlog pa ni gsal bar gsungs so/ /las thams cad pa gnyis ka'i dbus kyi pad+ma ljang gu dang de'i lte bar gtso bo'i sna tshogs rdo rje dang yum gyi chos 'byung gdam khar shong 'gyur las 'byung zhing / 'gyur gzhan las chos 'byung gi dbus su rdo rje 'god pa'ang bshad de/ sna tshogs rdo rje ni ljang gu'am sngon po rtse lnga pa la zer gyi rgya gram mi dgos so/

/lha ljang gu mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang bgrang phreng / g.yon gnyis dril bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa nam mkha'i sogs so/ /rgyas pa la gdan gsum khru do pa ste gzhan snga ma bzhin no/ /de ltar sbyin sreg byas pa'i dgos pa ni bden pa bzhi pa ye shes kyi me kun tu dga' ba'i chos sam/ ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /zhes pa rang byung lhan skyes kyi me de nyid mngon du bya ba'i phyir du yin te spyir me ni gsum ste/ lho'i me glog dang / khyim bdag gi me nyi ma dang / mchod sbyin gyi me sha za ste/ phung po thams cad bsregs nas za bar byed pa 'od gsal lo/ /'di la 'dod pa'i me'am 'dod pa'i lha zhes kyang bshad la/ nges don ye shes dang / drang don dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'o/ /nyi ma ni 'dir kun rdzob pa'i sbyin sreg gi me lha'i gtso bo yin te/ rta bdun la gnas pa gza' bdun gyi bdag po lce bdun dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ zhi ba la zla ba'i lce/ rgyas pa la nyi ma/ bsad bskrad dbye ba la spen pa/ dbang la pa sangs/ dgug pa la phur pa/ rmongs rengs la gza' lhag dang bkra shis kyi lce dang ldan pa gza' re re dag pas zhal gcig nyin mtshan dag pas zhabs gnyis/ thun mtshams bzhi dag pas phyag bzhi pa'o/ /bsad pa la mjug ring dag pas gri thod 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pa dang / dbye ba la spen pa dag pas ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis pa'ang phyogs gzhan la brten par bshad cing / las thams cad pa la zhi rgyas grangs bzhin du dus me dang sgra gcan rnam par dag ste 'jog pa dang skye ba'i chos can nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ gzhan dang rgyud rnams su bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang / cho ga'i lhag chad bso ba la sbyin sreg nges par dgos pa dang / de med na dngos grub mi 'grub par gsungs pas na 'di la nan tan du bya dgos so/ /'dir de ltar me gsum bshad pa'i mchod sbyin nam 'dod pa'i me rang gi lhar bshad pa tsam ma gtogs 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha bskyed chog sogs dngos su ma bshad pas 'khrul nas/

kha cig thab tu bskyed pa mchod sbyin gyi dang / snying khar bskyed pa 'dod pa'i dang / phyi nas spyan drang ba khyim gyi me ste de gsum dbye byed du byas pa dus 'khor rgyud 'grel dang mthun pa'i sbyin sreg yin gyi me lha 'das ma 'das lan gnyis byed pa rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyas bkab yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /mi 'thad de/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud thams cad la sngags pas shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas gzhan nas kha skong dgos par bstan pa'i phyir dang / mchod sbyin gyi me dang 'dod pa'i me gnyis gcig tu gsung nas de la slar yang sngar gyi khyim gyi me la phul ba'i mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas thams cad 'bul bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / de gnyis kyi bsreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig gi sngags so sor gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gshegs pa gshegs ma sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo thams cad la 'bul sngags so sor bshad pa'i phyir/ snying khar bskyed chog yod pas drang don gyi 'das par mi 'grub ste sa lha sta gon sogs la'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bu ston rin po che dam tshig gi sngags dang dgang blugs 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya sogs rang la nges pa can yod bzhin du gzhan nas kha 'gengs pa yang mi 'thad cing khro bo yum dang bcas par 'dir dngos su gsung pas srung 'khor ji bzhin mdzad pa'ang mi 'thad do/ /rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par dus 'khor las/ /legs par gsung pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga rnams/ /tshigs bcad sum cus tshad las rdzogs pa ni/ /go bder bshad 'dis sgrib gnyis kun bsreg shog/ ༈ /gnyis pa lag len mdor bsdus te bstan pa la/ zhi ba la zhib tu sbyar/ rgyas pa la mtshon te bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sdom du bsdu na bsham sgom bskyed sbar sbyor ba bzhi/ /sgrub mchod gnyis gnyis dngos gzhi bzhi/ /shis bsangs gshegs gnyis mjug chog bzhi/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i cho ga 'o/

/de yang mdun bskyed sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na/ brus rtsigs kyi thab kyi sa brtag blang dang / gzhan la'ang sbyang gzung rgyas bsdus gang 'grub phur gdab dang bcas pa byas la/ 'dir ni 'brel ba gtso bor byas nas bshad par bya ba la/ sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi sbyor ba la bzhi'i bsham pa la thab dang yo byad dang chas 'jug go /dang po ni bris pa'i dkyil 'khor byang phyogs byang shar la cung zad nye bar khru do'i pha rol du khru bdun pa'i tshad zur btab la srad bu mtho gang pa dang / de la sor gnyis dang bzhi dang bzhi mthud pa rnams kyis zlum skor byas pa'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar pad+ma dkar po/ 'dab ma rnams nang ler gzhan bshad kyang shar dang shar lho sogs bzhir ral gri gnyis/ rin po che gnyis/ rdo rje dang pad+ma gnyis/ 'khor lo gnyis rnams phyogs mdog dang / kha khyer gyi bar cha'i lnga gsum la pad+ma'i phreng ba dang de'i phyi ru pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa rtse mo phyir bstan pa dkar po bri/ de nas khru gnyis dor bar rtsa thig nas mda' thig gi bar btab pa'i rtsig pa rnams nang nas rim pa bzhin nag dmar dkar ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la byang du byas nas der sgo dang rta babs tshul bzhin du bris shing / rtsig pa'i nang du khro bo bcu'i mtshan ma ste steng 'og gnyis shar gyi shar dang nub kyi nub tu bri'o/ /thab kyi lho'am me lha sgo la rgyab bstan pa'i dbang du byas na shar du slob dpon dang / de'i g.yas su bsreg rdzas dang g.yon du mchod rdzas kyi gdan gyi pad+ma thab dang tshad dbyibs 'dra ba la 'dab ma'i mtshan ma dang mchu sogs med pa bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni g.yon gyi gdan la mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil gyi snod shel las byas pa pad+ma'i dbyibs can sor bcu gnyis pa gsum/ so so'i mdun du bzed zhal gyi snod dang bcas pa/ ku sha'i chun po/ gzhan yang tsan+dan dkar po'i dri chab/ dri zhim po'i me tog dkar po dang /

a ka ru dang sih+la dang ga pur gyi spos sbrang rtsi dang sha ka ra dang bcas pa ste bsil ba'i spos/ mar dkar gyi mar me/ 'o ma dang / zho zan gyi lha bshos/ 'bras sa li ma chags pa'i 'bru/ gos gzung dkar po rnams rim pa bzhin dang / rnam rgyal chen po nang mchod rdor dril rnams dang / g.yas la dgang blugs dang de'i mthar u dum+ba ra dang / a shat+thā dang / n+ya gro dha dang / sarka ṭi dang / dgun 'brum ste lnga'am ma rnyed na shug pa dang kham bu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing dri ro bzang po'i rtse mo'i cha las skyes pa mnyam par chad pa mdzub mo'i tshad tsam rlan dang bcas zhing lo ma gnyis dang ldan pa sor bcu gnyis pa de las ring thung dang sbom pa dang gas rul sogs med pa dri bzang dang sbyar ba'i mar gyis sbags pa lnga brgya dang lnga bcu me lha'i chas kyi lhag po dang bcas pa dang / til dang so ba dang 'bras ma chag pa dang nas dang / sran ma dang gro dang dur ba sngo ljang rnams kyang shing dang 'dra bar sbags pa dang / mthar zho zan sogs zas bzang pos bkang ba'i snod dang mdun du mar dkar dri ma med pa'i mar bzhu mi nyung ba dang bcas pa bshams shing shom pa'i tshe yang rang rang gi sngags rnams kyis ci 'grub dang / khyad par mchod yon sogs chu rnams la yig drug la swā hā btags pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzla shing bsham mo/ /gsum pa ni/ sgrub grogs dang bcas pa'i slob dpon rang nyid chas gos dkar po dri ma med pa shel rgyan gtsug tor mdun khebs thams cad dkar po dri zhim po'i phye ma sogs btab pa stan dkar po ha cang mtho ba ma yin pa rnams bsham/ dgon pa'i gci ba'am 'o ma can gyi shing sbom phra gang rnyed kyis thab kyi rgya dpang las mi che bar brtsig go /sgom pa ni/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i bdag bskyed ci 'grub bya la/ 'brel na phyi rol pa btang nas snga dro'am srod kyi thun dang po dus sbyor rtsub po dang bral ba 'dzom na dkar seng gi khyim 'char dus su slob dpon chas su zhugs te rkang pa byin gyis brlabs te rdo rje'i 'gros kyis thab kyi dkyil 'khor la skor nas sgo nang nas zhugs par mos te/

gdan la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis 'khod nas/ rang nyid rdo rje'i shugs zhal dkar po gtso bor byas pa zhi nyams can srung 'khor gyi 'don pa cung zad spos pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po las 'od dpag med dkar po sogs rigs drug dgod/ rnam rgyal chen po'i chus bsang gtor bya zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrāḥphaṭ/ rang dang thab dang bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang dgang blugs dang rdor dril sogs pa thams cad bgegs dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tās/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du bh+rūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo gcig pa rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi khro bo'i mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar dang shar lhor yi yi 'a dang / ral gri las skyes pa'i bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can nag po nag dmar sogs dang / de bzhin du lho dang lho nub tu t+ti t+ni dang rin po che sogs dang / steng dang 'og tu ha hā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtsug tor dang snod mdzes sogs srung 'khor ji bzhin la rang rang gi yum dang bcas pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gi bzhugs pa badz+ra bhai ra ba ya dzaḥ prañdzān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ ya mān+ta kṛ ta baṃ/ pad+man+ta kṛ ta hoḥ bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hi/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐ḥ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas gdan gsum tshang ba'i sogs nas/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par thim/ mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ bka' bsgo'o/ /bskyed pa la rdzas dang / thab bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ shū n+ya tās/ gdan dang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa pad+mas mtshan pa rnams kyi steng du pam̐ las grub pa'i shel gyi snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rdzas rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid bde ba chen po/

rnam pa mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas so so/ byed las dbang po nas bskyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā t+yaṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇa/ oṃ tsa ma naṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ kā ma rnams re re'i 'jug tu oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ zhes pas rdzas rnams bkru/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rnams kyi yam shing dang mar dang 'bru dang rdzas lhag ma rnams sbyangs/ byin gyis rlob pa ni mgor oṃ dang mthar swā hā sbyar nas/ shing lnga dang / mar dang ku sha dang / til nas zho zan gyi bar la/ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa/ yañdza/ la ma ta ku be ra/ ma dhu na/ badz+ra ag+ni/ a pra ti ha ta/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya/ badz+ra bi dza ya/ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa/ mahā be ga mahā ba la/ badz+ra ghasma ri/ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sarba saṃ sad de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ shū n+ya tā/ me thab stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las ye shes kyi thab kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum po/ rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed mchu dang re kha'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa de'i nang gi dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa mtshan ma dgu dang bcas pas brgyan zhing kha khyer la pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba dang kha khyer gyi 'og tu pad+ma'i 'dab mas yongs su skor ba dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥthab kyi mthar dur ba sngo ljang dgram/ sbar ba ni bram ze'i me'am 'o ma can gyi shing gi sbar ba'i me blang la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis snod du bsrungs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥs me mdung sbar/ yig drug gi bsang / oṃ dz+wā la dz+wā la hūm̐ haṃṣamalawaraya gis khas mi bu bar rlung g.yab kyi sbar/ gtso bo'i snying pos blugs gzar bdun gyis bso'o/ /sbyor ba'o// ༈ //dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi 'jig rten pa'i me lha sgrub mchod ni/ bskyed stim drangs gzhug mchod 'bul bzhu/ /zhes pas bsdus te/ bskyed pa ni/ shū n+ya tā/ me stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum bkra shis kyi mtshan pa'i dbus su me lha'i gdan wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dang bcas pa/

rang gi snying ga dang thab kyi me lha'i gdan la pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du wam̐ dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i me lha dkar po/ snang mthas dbu brgyan cing zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang shel phreng / g.yon gnyis dung dang ril ba 'dzin pa/ na bza' dkar po bsnabs shing mu tig la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan dkar pos brgyan pa/ pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs shing zla ba'i lce'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i thab kyi me lha khro bo bcus bsrung bar gyur/ snying kha'i me lha'i thugs kar dzaḥyongs su gyur pa las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro bar gyur/ dzaḥrang 'dra'i me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐ dam tshig pa la bcug baṃ dbyer med du bcings/ hoḥmanyes par byas/ hi ro mnyam du byas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan cig tu nang gi me lha phyir 'phros nas thab kyi me lha la thim/ 'dir mthe bong gis rdo rje khu tshur mnan pa'i phyag rgya bstan/ oṃ e h+ye hi mahā bhū tā de wa ri ṣi dwi dzaḥ sat+t+waṃ gṛ hi to/ a yu dha mahā rasmi san+ni hi to bha ba badz+ra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ ces pa gnyis dang / de'i bod skad/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /'od chen mtshon 'dzin 'dir mnyes mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod/ /swā hā/ zhes gsol ba btab pa dang / thugs kha nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis ri rab lhun po'i me mtshams kyi rwa la gnas pa'i me lha 'khor drang srong gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs te/ thab kyi phyi rol gyi dur ba'i gdan la 'khod/ bgegs bsreg pa'i sngags kyis phyi 'breng bskrad/ dzaḥme lha 'khor bcas thab tu spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ bam̐/ ho/ hi rnams snga ma bzhin/ oṃ ma hā rasmi prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

oṃ pra wa ra satwa ka raṃ mahā rasmi pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ gyi gnas su/ āṃ tsa ma naṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nas/ kā ma/ pā dh+yaṃ/ sa pa ri wā ra ya na ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa phyibs/ /rigs sngags gsung ba'i bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gaṇ+ḍi bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la stsol/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba mnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi kha la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od zer dang bcas pas mtshan zhing me lha 'dzum bag dang bcas pa cung zad gdangs pa'i lce la raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a na la/ sarba bhū taṃ dz+wā la ya sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru ku ru sarba dza na duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ bsreg blugs bdun 'bul/ zhes phul bas zhal du gsol nas/ bsreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig la gnas pas bsreg blugs len cing phrin las sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur/ me pra ngan na bgegs bsreg yig drug gis bsang / snying pos blugs gzar bdun gyi me bsos nas/ slar yang lha gsal gdab/ bsreg blugs bdun phul/ bzang na mi dgos/ oṃ mahā rasmi bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ de bzhin du yam shing gzhi la sbyar/ ag+ne yes blugs gzar bdun/ de nas til/ so ba/ 'bras/ nas/ sran ma/ gro rnams re re zhing bdun bdun gyi mthar yang blugs gzar/

de nas dur ba bdun/ bsreg blugs bdun rnams re re'i mjug tu'am kun gyi mthar che ge mo'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ me lha tshim shing mnyes nas 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ 'das pa'i sgrub mchod ni/ bskyed drangs mchod gsal 'bul tshan lnga/ /zhes bya ste/ rten bskyed pa ni/ me lha sngar bzhin bskyed pa'i dbus su 'byung ba rim rtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje gur gyi nas/ 'phro ba can te re re'ang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par gyur/ mdun bskyed ma 'brel na mdun bskyed sgrub tshul bsdus pa bya/ 'brel na sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ mtshan sngags sam 'chad 'gyur gyis bsreg sngags kyis dkyil 'khor nas spyan drangs pa'i mos pas me tog re re nas blangs pa thab tu'ang rim gyis sam cig char du dor nas/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dus kyi 'khor lor zhi ba'i zhal gtso bor gyur pa'i lha drug brgya sum cu so drug mtshan ma dang bcas pa thams cad mngon sum du gsal bar gyur/ mahā rasmi'i gnas su shrī ka la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra bcug pa'i mchod pa'i me lha bzhin phul/ 'dud nyi shu sogs kyis bstod/ bsreg blugs/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ag+ni badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swā hā/ zhes pa bdun gyi phul/ gtso bo'i thugs kar zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du yi ge dzaḥyongs su gyur pa las rdo rje lcags kyu/ de las dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros pas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag bkang nas des srid pa gsum po mtha' dag la khyab byed du gnas pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te gtso bo'i gtsug tor nas zhugs/

a ba dhū ti'i lam nas 'khor lo drug rim gyis brgyud pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyis pad+mar babs pa'i yab kyi dkar cha ā lis mtshan pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / yum gyi dmar cha kā lis mtshan pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i zla nyi kha sbyar gyi dbus su waṃ dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i lha'i bu zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ na bza' dkar po bsnams shing mu tig la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan dkar pos brgyan pa/ sgrub bya'i khyim du bskul nas des sgrub bya 'khor bcas bkug ste dkyil 'khor du bcug pa la/ gtso bos 'di la zhi ba'i las gyis shig ces bka' bskul/ yum rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis khrus gsol/ nus ma rnams kyis mchod par byed cing sems ma drug gis tshe dang dbang thang la sogs pa nyams pa bsos/ sgeg sogs rnams kyis tshim par byed cing tsa rtsi ka la sogs pa rnams kyis 'jigs pa med par byed/ khro mo rnams kyis skyong par byed cing klu mo rnams kyis 'o byed/ lha mo bcu gnyis kyis 'khyud par byed cing gtum mo rnams kyis bsrung bar byed pa'i sgo nas zhi ba'i phrin las la brtson par gyur/ yam shing nas/ mtha'i bsreg blugs kyi bar sngar bzhin las bsreg blugs bdun bdun dang / gzhan rnams re re yang brgya rtsa brgyad re/ dang por yig drug dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa/ de nas yan lag gi sa bon/ oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hṛṃ hruṃ hl̥ṃ hraḥdang / a i ṛ u l̥ aṃ dang / a e ar o al aṃ dang / ha ya ra wa la rnams ring thung ste sngags sde tshan lnga po re re la'ang tshang ma spel tshig rgyas bsdus gang rung dang bcas pa phul la/ 'jug ni/ rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du phyin/ zas bzang po dang chu gtor te/ oṃ bh+yur bhū ba swā hā/

na mo de we bh+yaḥ swa sti pra dze bh+yaḥ swā hā rā dze bh+yaḥ swa dhā pri tri bh+yaḥ a lam+bhū te bh+yaḥ wa ṣaṭa in+t+ra ya/ zhes pa gnyis dang / de bod skad du/ oṃ sa 'og sa steng legs sbyin pa'i/ /lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye rgu rnams la bkra shis dang / /rgyal po rnams la dbugs dbyung dang / /pha mes rnams la ro myangs dang / /'byung po rnams la tshim pa dang / /dbang po rnams ni dbang byed shog /ces 'thor shing / shis brjod bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya waka tsit+ta swā bha wa bi shu dha swā hā/ ku sha'i chus rang rang dkyil 'khor pa la bsang oṃ badz+ra waskra swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu la swā hās gos gsar pa dang rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi phul/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yi/ /zhes sogs dang / gang yang bdag cag las dang po par gyur te/ bying rgod kyi dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / snyigs ma lnga'i dbang gis yo byad ma 'byor shing ma rnyed pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gi mchod pa'i dngos po chung zhing ngan pa dang / gti mug gi dbang gis rgyud sde nas 'byung pa'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad mgon po thugs rje sogs dang yig brgya brjod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed med na mngon rtogs bzhin rang la bsdu/ yod na/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /mtshan sngags sogs kyi me tog thab nas blang la/ mdun bskyed la bsdu/ de nas thab tu me lha gsal btab pa la bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams dbul/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gsol gdab byas la/ oṃ dzaḥgats+tsha gats+tsha ma hā rasmi swā hā/ baṃ san+t+ri sto hon/ su na rā ga mi ṣ+ya si de ba s+ya ya dā ā hā na ya mi swā hā/ gnyis dang / bod skad/ 'od chen yang dag tshim mnyes te/ /rang gnas gshegs gshegs gang gi tshe/ /lha 'dir spyan 'dren bgyid pa na/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/

swā hā/ se gol gtog ye shes kyi me lha rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu rang gi snying gar thim zhing / 'jig rten gyi me lha rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ gang dag steng na sogs kyis shis brjod bya/ 'jug chog gzhan dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bya'o/ /sbyin bdag yod na/ 'das pa ma gshegs gong ngam shis brjod kyi gong du lag g.yon pa dgang blugs dang bcas pas de'i mthe bong g.yas pa nas bzung ste/ bsreg blugs bdun dang g.yas pas blugs gzar bdun de'i mgo bo'i g.yas su skor shing 'bul bar gzhan du bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /rgyas pa la yang cho ga phal cher khyad med la/ thab dang 'dug stangs dang spel tshig zhi ba'i las mdzad pa'i gnas su rgyas pa'i las mdzod zhes sogs gzhug ste/ rnam bzhag la shin tu bltas nas 'don pa rnams ci rigs su spo zhing / dkyil 'khor dang grong gi byang drang po nyid du bya'o/ /de ltar rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /sbyin sreg rnam bzhag nyer mkho'i lag len dang / /bcas pa 'di ni stag tshang lo tsā ba/ /shes rab rin chen zhes byas legs par sbyar/ /nyes cha'i bud shing mkhas pa'i me lha yis/ /slar yang rmongs pa'i yam shing dang bcas te/ /bsregs nas ye shes chen po'i snang ba yis/ /skyes rgu 'di yi mun pa sel gyur cig /'dir 'bad dge dang rang gzhan dge ba kun/ /dmigs med ngang du rnam mkhyen kho nar bsngo/ /'gro kun srid zhi'i dpal 'byor cher rgyas nas/ /sku bzhi'i dpal la ring min spyod par shog /ces myos ldan gyi lo sgron gyi zla ba'i nyi shu drug rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'jam pa'i rdo rje rin po che bsod nams 'phel gyi zhal snga nas kyis zla dus kyi mchod pa la dmigs te sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// //gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan stag tshang pas/

/mdo sngags gsung rab kun la dgongs 'grel dang / /khyad par dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum rigs ldan bzhed pa'i gzhung / /'gro ba'i kun dkris bag chags bsreg pa'i thabs/ /sbyin sreg cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho mdzad/ /mdzad pa'i 'od dkar phyogs kun khyab pa'i phyir/ /ku mud 'dul bya'i tha chung dpon ching gis/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa chen pos bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /'gro la phan bde'i snang chen rgyas par shog/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 stag tshang lo tsā ba/ dus 'khor gyi sbyin sreg cho ga/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
